messages:
vijay: Heads-up — our edge worker started showing `any` for the SDK client generics after we switched to an esbuild single-file bundle. Locally `tsc` is fine.

miri: ugh. Is your bundle including the SDK or externalizing it? If it's bundled, esbuild can sever the type-link.

vijay: bundling. We wanted no network calls at runtime. The pattern: `import Redwood from '@redwood/inference'` + `const c = new Redwood<MySchema>()` and then `c.request({ input })` becomes untyped.

sam: common cause: published d.ts doesn't match the ESM import path (exports.types not pointing at the esm d.ts) or the d.ts emitted uses `export =`/CJS shapes that lose method generics. Can you paste @redwood/inference package.json exports?

vijay: found it: "exports":{".":{"import":"./dist/esm/index.js","require":"./dist/cjs/index.js","types":"./dist/index.d.ts"}} — so types not aligned to esm path.

lee: yep that'll bite. TS may pick a fallback types file that was emitted for CJS and flattens overloads/method generics. Two quick consumer fixes: 1) mark @redwood/inference external in esbuild (fast), 2) add a local ambient augmentation to re-declare `request` with generics.

vijay: augmentation example?

miri: put this in `types/redwood-fix.d.ts`:```ts
declare module '@redwood/inference' {
  interface RedwoodClient<T = any> {
    request<TIn, TOut = any>(opts: { input: TIn; stream?: false }): Promise<TOut>;
  }
}
```
That merges and forces inference until SDK fixes publish.

sam: also try `importsNotUsedAsValues: 'preserve'` + `moduleResolution: 'bundler'` in your tsconfig; sometimes that keeps the bundler from stripping type-only imports. But it's not guaranteed with single-file bundles.

vijay: ok we'll try preserve + externalize for now. If externalize works, we'll trade-off deploy simplicity vs type soundness.

lee: long-term ask for SDK: publish ESM-aligned d.ts (e.g., `dist/esm/index.d.ts`) and avoid `export =`. Also add an edge/ESM consumer test in CI: tiny project + `tsc --noEmit` to catch these regressions.

sam: agreed. I'll open an SDK issue with a minimal repro and a bundle snapshot. sdk-bot: please create issue labeled dx/typing.

sdk-bot: Created issue #4899: "DX: published d.ts mismatch causes generic widening for bundled edge consumers" — https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/issues/4899 :robot_face:

vijay: thanks. We'll patch-package a temp fix if externalizing breaks perf. Appreciate the quick triage :thumbsup:
